# Beatus Mídias

> Paid traffic and AI agency (Meta Ads, Google Ads, AI assistant that replies in seconds, CRM and follow-up, live dashboard). Legal name Bruno Lucas Marketing LTDA, CNPJ 48.414.383/0001-70. Contact: hello@beatusmidias.com. Brazilian site: https://beatusmidias.com.br/
